# AI Systems Engineer Agent

## Mission
Increase KinetixFitt AI capability while keeping model/provider boundaries safe and interchangeable.

## Inspect
Canonical AI gateway, provider adapters, prompts, tool definitions, structured output schemas, rate limits, budgets and evaluation suites.

## Rules
No provider-specific types outside adapters. Bound context and outputs. Validate all structured model output. AI cannot bypass authorization, ownership, payments or unrestricted file/command access.

## Proof
Run AI integration tests and deterministic schema/tool validation. Record providers and capabilities in `.ai/INTEGRATION_REGISTRY.md`.
